Here is a comparison shot. I will explain each part.

http://imgur.com/a/603BF

First picture is the default mod mail.

This mod mail isn't too bad at first glance. It is ok for smaller subs or when you don't have many subs to moderate(please note that all screenshots are taken from a specific sub so it doesn't show all subs present) however it is missing tons of functions which toolbox adds.

Second picture displays all the options.

All:

Displays all mail from all subs the user is in. This is what reddit displays by default without toolbox.

Priority:

The subs you actually care about and do work on. This is the default tab. Filtered:

You click a little button and it puts subs you have toggled to go into this section. This is good for mod mail chat subs like dickgirls or other joke subs so it doesn't clutter mail you actually want to read or need to read.

Replied:

Mail you or another mod has replied to(I think it works if the user replies as well.

Unread:

Mail that hasn't been seen yet. These messages default to the top of the page if they were the last messages made

Unanswered:

Mail that has been read but was not replied to.

Collapse All:

Makes it so it only shows the title of the message and the user who sent it. Not the actual text from within. This is useful for when mods have already seen the mail or replied to it so it doesn't continue to clutter the mail.

New Messages:

The obvious.

Third image displays the compose mod mail and switch mod mail sections(opens a new tab for the designated one you choose.)

Now the issue with toolbox. It still loads all messages from all subs even if some are filtered meaning you could be loading hundreds if not thousands of messages depending on the subs you moderate. Each reply to a message is considered a new message. You can't do anything while this loads and it cripples most computers who use it.

Another issue with modmail that makes it a problem if someone replies to a thread it pushes it to the top of the page even if it is months old. There is also no search function present so it can take hours to find something you need unless you bookmarked it.

I may have left something out but let me know if I did.

Without it is basically Voat when it comes to modding.
